subject: Zenova Renewal & Expansion MAP — kickoff and 90-day orchestration
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenova.com>, Marco Li <marco.li@zenova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Zenova Renewal & Expansion MAP — kickoff and 90-day orchestration

Hi Elena / Marco —

Thanks for taking the time to align on the upcoming renewal and potential expansion. Per our renewal timeline, your renewal window opens in Q4 and there are clear opportunities to increase embeddings and dedicated throughput for your inference pipelines. To keep things concrete, I put together a short mutual action plan (attached) that recommends a 90-day cadence to reach the target expansion.

Goal summary (top-level):
- Confirm renewal terms and finalize SOW (target: end of Q3)
- Increase embedding throughput by 2x for recommendation workloads
- Pilot Dedicated cluster for high-throughput inference (POC in 30 days)

Proposed kickoff checklist / roles:
- Zenova exec sponsor: Elena Rossi (decision authority)
- Zenova engineering: Marco Li (technical lead)
- Redwood CSM: Marissa Cole (usage + onboarding)
- Redwood Finance / Deals: Stephanie Nguyen (pricing & contract)
- Redwood AE: Connor O'Brien (overall owner)

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm the stakeholders above or add anyone else who needs to be in the MAP.
2) Can you share the current average daily embedding volume (tokens/requests) and the target for peak traffic by September? A quick CSV is fine.
3) Would next Wednesday (Jun 25) 10:00–11:00 CEST work for a 60-minute workshop to agree SLAs, milestones, and procurement steps?

I've attached a draft MAP (zenova_map_draft.pdf) and a short procurement timeline template. If that date doesn't work, propose two alternatives and we'll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: zenova_map_draft.pdf, procurement_timeline.xlsx
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenova.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Li <marco.li@zenova.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 14:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Zenova Renewal & Expansion MAP — kickoff and 90-day orchestration

Connor —

Thanks for the clear summary and the draft MAP. Confirmed: I will be the exec sponsor and Marco is the technical lead for the evaluation. A couple of quick items from our side:

- Procurement timeline: our procurement window for renewals closes mid-September, but we need internal terms cleared by late August to hit that.
- Usage data: I'll ask Marco to pull the daily embedding count export. He may prefer to send that directly to Marissa.
- Workshop: Jun 25 at 10:00 CEST works for me.

Two requests before the workshop:
1) Can you include a short agenda that lists the procurement milestones and a proposed rollout split (pilot / phased rollout)?
2) We have a security reviewer — Luca Bianchi — who may need SOC 2 artifacts and retention details before we sign off on Dedicated capacity. Please mark security as a separate line item in the MAP.

I'll await the agenda and the usage export.

Best,
Elena
VP Product, Zenova
elena.rossi@zenova.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenova.com>
Cc: Marco Li <marco.li@zenova.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zenova Renewal & Expansion MAP — kickoff and 90-day orchestration

Connor / Elena / Marco —

Thanks — I pulled a short usage snapshot and attached it (usage_snapshot_q1_q2.csv). High level notes:
- Avg daily embedding calls: ~42k (April–May), spikes up to ~70k on heavy test days.
- Primary consumer: recommendation microservice (80% of tokens).
- Current latency SLOs are fine, but cost per 1M tokens spikes during peak due to synchronous small-batch inference.

For the workshop agenda I propose:
1) 15m Introductions & goals (Elena + Connor)
2) 20m Usage review & bottlenecks (Marissa + Marco)
3) 15m Dedicated vs hosted economic comparison (Stephanie + Connor)
4) 10m Security checklist & artifacts needed (Marissa)
5) 10m Next steps & owners

I can present the usage dashboard live — link: https://app.redwood.com/usage/zenova/dashboard — and we can export any additional numbers live.

I'll also pre-seed the MAP with the security checklist and expected artifact names so Luca can expedite review.

Attachments: usage_snapshot_q1_q2.csv

—Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenova.com>, Marco Li <marco.li@zenova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 12:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Zenova Renewal & Expansion MAP — kickoff and 90-day orchestration

Perfect — thanks Marissa and Elena. I've updated the MAP to include a security line item and added the procurement milestone in late August. A few specific calls to action ahead of the workshop:

- Marco: please send the usage CSV (or give Marissa access to the export) by EOD Tue so we can finalize cost scenarios.
- Elena: confirm whether legal prefers us to submit a draft SOW before or after the technical pilot. We can be flexible but want to set expectations with Finance.
- Stephanie: looping you in to confirm contractual levers (60/90 day payment terms, committed spend discount bands).

Agenda and updated MAP are attached again. I also added an internal upsell target: +25% embeddings volume within 90 days post-pilot (target metric for OKR alignment). We will quantify uplift in the workshop.

See you on Jun 25 at 10:00 CEST — I'll send a calendar invite with Zoom and a short prep deck.

Best,
Connor

Attachments: zenova_map_draft.pdf
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@zenova.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Li <marco.li@zenova.com>, Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@zenova.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 15:47:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Zenova Renewal & Expansion MAP — kickoff and 90-day orchestration

Connor / team —

Thanks, all looks good. Confirmed: Luca (copied) will handle the security review and will list any SOC 2 / retention docs he needs ahead of the workshop. Marco will share the CSV by EOD.

One small ask on procurement: can Redwood provide a quick template of typical SOW milestones aligned to payment triggers? That will help our procurement team (I copied our procurement lead on a follow-up internal thread).

We'll be prepared on Jun 25.

Regards,
Elena

Attachments referenced: procurement_timeline.xlsx
